name: qorvex
description: Reverse engineer anything from your terminal or agent with one CLI and MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Use QORVEX to explain shipped behavior from native binaries, managed assemblies, Electron and JavaScript bundles, packages, firmware, and browser targets, with evidence that separates observations from inferences.
defaultPrompt: Use QORVEX to explain how this binary implements a feature.
Use QORVEX to compare two versions of this application.
Use QORVEX to recover the sources from this JavaScript bundle.
